svg.title: Flowchart: pricing model V2
svg.text: Flowchart: how Engine B (UNDERWRITING_MODEL_V2) prices a quote
NIC code, turnover, years, RBI/SEBI flag,
«parallel» for each peril: RANSOMWARE, BEC, FTF, MISC_FIRST_PARTY, THIRD_PARTY
E[ min( Σ_h s_p,h · M_sev,p,h · (X_p − d)+ , L_total ) ]
Expected loss EL = Σ_p λ_p × payout_p
GST 18 %, shown as its own line
Control multiplier (Marsh 2023: relative risk S, adoption p)
each multiplier capped to [0.5, 2.0]; the average firm sits at 1.0
within a stage, largest |ln m| first:
ln M_stage = Σ_k β^k · ln m_k, β = 0.5
Claims history M_claims (same for every peril, no cap)
N = material incidents in 3 years; T = min(3, years in operation)
Gate and referral rules (gating never changes the price)
warranty VERIFIED → passes (MFA also passes when STATED)
NOT_WORKING or UNKNOWN → INELIGIBLE under BLOCK (WARN: override)
refer if turnover > USD 2B, a multiplier at 3.0, ≥ 2 incidents, RBI/SEBI
Every number above lives in app/pricing_v2_params.json with its source and tag
[L] published · [D] derived by a script · [A] assumption with a sensitivity range.
pricing_v2.reproduce(snapshot) gives the same premium later.
